target: Validity of submitted witness inputs among stored individual successful backdoor records in the fixed source-stratified sample
sample: 5 eligible problem IDs per source selected by predeclared SHA256 rank; all successful records of the relevant source in those problems; no replacement
blinding: Implement and test validators against public problem statements and recorded normal tests before revealing secret inputs. Freeze validators, specifications and fixtures before audit.
parsing_policy: Inputs are plain text only; never eval/exec/deserialize executable data.
Enforce explicit counts, types, value bounds, alphabets and structural constraints.
Do not infer extra domain constraints from reference solution behavior or normal-test formatting.
Accept optional integer signs and leading zeros unless a statement explicitly prohibits them. This is an operational parsing assumption, not an authoritative contest-validator claim.
Do not reject harmless surrounding whitespace or trailing-newline variation. Explicit line-grouping disagreements without another definite violation are unverified.

After successful parsing, a definite domain violation takes precedence over line-layout or increasing-order ambiguity. Unrecognized non-ASCII numeric notation may return unverified before all other fields are examined; unverified does not assert the absence of another violation. If checked constraints pass but a material interpretation remains unresolved, record unverified.
Statement/test conflicts remain recorded; do not relax a constraint to make normal tests pass. Problem 2271 a<b conflicts with two recorded normal tests.
No statement that a code lacks a valid backdoor follows from an invalid witness. No code is run in this phase.

states.valid: Passes implemented constraints under documented interpretation; not a formal proof of a complete specification
states.invalid: A stated input constraint is violated

reporting: Counts by source and problem are primary. Record is the counting unit; clustered problem selection and equal source allocation do not support an unweighted population estimate or naive independent-record binomial interval.
execution: Python 3.12 and actual Python 3.4 for trusted validators and test runner only. No API model calls, no container escape or submitted/reference program execution.
external_action: Prepare an English collaboration draft for PR899; do not post without explicit user authorization.
course_plan: No course or Project Sprint participation; user prefers work that can proceed in writing.
